mapper.select: SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_poem cp WHERE cp.collection_id = c.id) AS poem_count FROM collection c ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_poem cp WHERE cp.collection_id = c.id) AS poem_count FROM collection c WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT m.id, m.title, m.subtitle, m.poet_id, m.dynasty, m.genre, m.paragraphs, m.mood, m.famous_line, m.tier, m.create_time, p.name AS poet_name, p.years AS poet_years, p.title AS poet_title FROM collection_poem cp JOIN poem m ON m.id = cp.poem_id JOIN poet p ON p.id = m.poet_id WHERE cp.collection_id = #{id} ORDER BY cp.sort_no ASC
